title: Next run of a cron schedule
prompt:
The job scheduler needs `next_run(expr, after)` in app/cron.py for the minute and hour fields of a cron expression
(`"M H * * *"`; the other three fields are always `*`). Each field accepts `*`, `*/n`, a number, a range `a-b` and
comma lists of those. Return the first `datetime` strictly after `after` (seconds and microseconds zeroed) that
matches. Invalid expressions raise `ValueError`.
